Remaining a major shareholder does not imply no other corporate interests or that he has no influence.

2019 annual-report biography confirms Zhejiang computer-science bachelor’s and Wisconsin–Madison computer-science master’s, not doctorate. Degree completion dates are omitted. Google start in 2004 as software engineer and project manager is independently consistent with Forbes.

2019 report identifies Xinyoudi Studio founded in 2011 for online games and Ouku.com consumer-electronics business sold in 2010. The Edge corroborates Ouku founding in 2007. Do not conflate Ouku, Leqi and Xinyoudi or invent sale proceeds.

2015 founding is distinct from holding-company incorporation date, platform launch month and later rebranding. Use year only. Team buying combines pooled orders and social sharing; no claim that Huang invented all group buying or guarantees lowest prices.

Investor FAQ establishes Nasdaq trading began July 26, 2018 under PDD. ADSs are not identical to individual ordinary shares; each ADS represents four Class A ordinary shares. Offering size, proceeds and market capitalization omitted to avoid conflation.

Temu launched under the group in 2022 and parent renamed PDD Holdings in 2023, after his formal exits. Do not describe him as current Temu CEO or independently date his personal founding of Temu. Original influence rating/rationale retained unchanged under campaign rules.

Food and life-science research is his announced direction upon leaving management. No scientific appointment, discovery or completed breakthrough inferred. Company press releases are attributed corporate sources, not independent validation of platform superlatives.
